content.short: Fables is a hook-native ve(3,3) exchange on Uniswap v4 with pair-specific dynamic fees.
content.description: Fables is a hook-native ve(3,3) exchange built on Uniswap v4, live on Robinhood Chain. It uses v4 hooks to set fees per pair dynamically, so each market carries a schedule suited to its own volatility instead of one applied across every pool. Emissions are directed by lockers in the usual ve(3,3) pattern.
